mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may increase serotonergic activity and potentially affect hormonal contraceptive efficacy through enzyme induction and altered metabolism, while levonorgestrel may theoretically increase MAOI-related hypertensive effects through sympathomimetic potentiation.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; consider alternative contraception or antidepressant; counsel on dietary tyramine restriction and warn of potential reduced contraceptive reliability.
